# HUDGear — Advanced Equipment HUD

A professional real-time durability HUD for Minecraft 26.1.x.
Displays exact durability percentages for all equipped gear with
full customization through an advanced in-game settings menu.

---

## Features

- **Armor tracking** — Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots
- **Weapon & Tool tracking** — Main Hand, Off Hand
- **Exact percentages** — 99%, 98%, 97%... real-time updates
- **Horizontal & Vertical layout** — switch between display modes
- **Individual toggles** — enable/disable each item separately
- **Live preview** — see changes instantly while in settings

---

## Color System

| Color | Durability |
|---|---|
| 🟢 Green | 60 – 100% |
| 🟡 Yellow | 35 – 59% |
| 🔴 Red | 0 – 34% |

---

## Controls

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| **K** | Open Settings Menu |

> ⚠️ **Note:** Keybind is fixed and cannot be changed.
> It is pre-configured and not listed in Minecraft's Controls settings menu.

---

## Settings Menu

- **HUD: ON/OFF** — enable or disable the entire HUD
- **X / Y Position** — place HUD anywhere on screen
- **HUD Scale** — resize the entire HUD
- **Item Spacing** — adjust space between items
- **Horizontal Layout** — switch from vertical to horizontal display
- **Show Percentage** — toggle percentage text on/off
- **Percentage Position** — customize where % text appears
- **Percentage X / Y** — fine-tune % text position
- **Per-item toggles** — Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots,
  Main Hand, Off Hand individually on/off
- **Preview** — live preview while adjusting settings
- **Save / Reset / Cancel**

---

## Requirements

- Minecraft **26.1.x**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.2+**
- Fabric API

---

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 26.1.x
2. Download Fabric API and place in `mods` folder
3. Place `HUDGear.jar` in `mods` folder
4. Launch Minecraft
5. Press **K** to open settings

---

*Client-side only — works on any server, no server installation needed.*
